name: Westmere Infiniband MPI Performance Benchmark
description: Measures MPI communication performance (latency, throughput) and overall scalability on Westmere-based Infiniband HPC clusters.
evaluation_method: measured system metrics (latency and throughput/bandwidth) and scalability curves
reputation: A specialized HPC benchmark for Westmere-era Infiniband clusters; historically useful within HPC performance analysis but hardware-specific and less cited outside that niche.
notes: Hardware- and configuration-dependent results; benchmark is tied to older Westmere hardware and Infiniband generations, so results are not directly comparable to modern systems; non-ML benchmark.
